atoms.b: The 𝘯th term of a linear sequence is given by the formula 𝘢𝘯 + 𝘣, where '𝘢' is the ((term_position additive ++common_difference)), '𝘯' is the ((++term_position additive common_difference)) and '𝘣' is the ((term_position ++additive common_difference)).
atoms.sound: The enth term of a linear sequence is given by the formula A N + b, where A is the common difference, N is the term position and B is the additive.

atoms.b: The 𝘯th term can also be written as <mat><gap>++b-an a(n-b)</gap></mat>.
atoms.sound: the enth term can also be written as b minus a N
